facts.fact: Adwave states that streaming TV channels running Target and Best Buy ads are accessible to small businesses starting at $50.
facts.quote: the same streaming channels running Target and Best Buy ads are accessible to businesses like yours, starting at just $50.

facts.fact: According to Adobe Analytics, Americans spent $9.8 billion on Black Friday 2023.
facts.quote: Americans spent $9.8 billion on Black Friday 2023 and $12.4 billion on Cyber Monday, according to Adobe Analytics.

facts.fact: Adwave's suggested October awareness budget for BFCM TV testing is $100-200.
Adwave's suggested early-November promotion-teaser budget is $200-300.
Adwave's suggested Black Friday/Cyber Monday week full-campaign budget is $500-1,000.
Adwave's starter BFCM strategy totals $500, split as $100 October, $150 November, and $250 BFCM week.
Adwave's growth BFCM strategy totals $1,000, with $200 October, $300 November, and $500 BFCM week.
Adwave assumes an average CPM of $25 when estimating its starter $500 BFCM plan's reach of roughly 20,000 impressions.
facts.quote: At an average CPM of $25, that's roughly 20,000 impressions reaching your target audience throughout the season.

facts.fact: Adwave's growth $1,000 BFCM plan is estimated to deliver approximately 40,000 impressions.
facts.quote: That's approximately 40,000 impressions, with heavier weight when it matters most.

facts.fact: Adwave suggests local businesses target a radius of 10-25 miles around their location, depending on market.
facts.quote: Target a radius around your location (10-25 miles depending on your market)

facts.fact: Adwave identifies the 25-54 age range as the peak gift-buying demographic for holiday targeting.
Adwave claims Facebook and Instagram CPMs spike 2-3x during the holiday season (unsourced claim).
facts.quote: Facebook and Instagram CPMs spike 2-3x during holiday season.

facts.fact: Adwave advises that the Black Friday TV campaign timeline should begin in October, with planning starting now for the holiday season.
facts.quote: You need to start planning now (yes, in October) to capture your share of the biggest shopping season of the year.

facts.fact: Adwave advises that a two-week awareness run is used for its starter October budget.
AdWave states that Black Friday CPMs run 20 to 40% higher than normal periods due to advertiser competition.
facts.quote: Black Friday CPMs run 20 to 40% higher than normal periods due to advertiser competition.

facts.fact: AdWave states that a typical small business might spend $500 to $1,500 during the extended Black Friday period, split between pre-event awareness and event-day promotion.
facts.quote: A typical small business might spend $500 to $1,500 during the extended Black Friday period

facts.fact: AdWave recommends starting Black Friday TV advertising 2 to 3 weeks before Black Friday.
facts.quote: Start 2 to 3 weeks before Black Friday to build awareness before the shopping frenzy.

facts.fact: AdWave recommends that TV campaigns continue through Cyber Monday and the following week.
facts.quote: Continue through Cyber Monday and the following week to capture extended holiday shoppers.

facts.fact: AdWave states that October is when awareness-building for BFCM advertising should start.
facts.quote: October is when awareness-building should start. BFCM week is too late to introduce your brand.
